attributes.name: Gholdako
attributes.powers:
The Gholdako is immune to the Mental and Poison traits.

Damage dealt by the Gholdako is dealt to each character at your location.

If the check to defeat has the Attack or Ranged trait, the difficulty is increased by 10.

If undefeated, examine the top 3 cards of your deck. Recharge 1, discard 1, and bury 1.
If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.

corrections.corrected_text: On the henchman Gholdako, add "The Gholdako is immune to the Mental and Poison traits."
corrections.issue: The Gholdako is undead. Shouldn't it be immune to the Mental and Poison traits?
